pages.title: Item Tooltips
pages.text: Hover over a seed or crop item:$(li)$(info)Matures in X days$() - roughly how many MC days this crop needs.$(li)Seeds given seasons in the config also show their $(info)season words$().$(li)Bone meal lists $(info)uses per crop per day, next 6 AM settlement, at least one stage$(), plus a warning that overuse withers crops.

pages.title: With Jade Installed
pages.text: Looking at a crop, Jade shows:$(li)the real $(bold)growth percentage$() rather than vanilla stage numbers$(li)$(info)Fertilizing: fertilized / not fertilized$() - whether a use is queued for the next settlement$(li)$(warn)Thirsty: waiting for water$() in red - it has lost its water$(li)$(info)Fertilized today 1/1$() in gold - the daily allowance is spent by you or a maid$(br2)Jade is optional; without it nothing changes mechanically, you simply lose these hints.

pages.title: Screens & Action Bar
pages.text: Right-clicking the $(l:seedseasons:agriculture/irrigator)Irrigator$() opens a $(water)blue-and-white gauge$(): blue is the water you have, white is the empty space, one notch per bucket, and hovering shows the current amount and total capacity. Press $(bold)E$() or $(bold)ESC$() to close.$(br2)Over-fertilizing or being blocked by the season also pops a short message in the action bar, so you always know what happened.
